dialogues.speaker: Childishly Written Notice
dialogues.text: "Spin the wheel, and when it stops, 'Hot Dog' will tell you your fortune!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'With the doe as your guide, your journey goes smoothly.'\nThis means everything you do today will go exactly as planned!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'The morning dew gathers as pearls, berries grow in abundance.'\nThis means you'll get some sort of windfall today."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'The lanterns burn eternal, lighting the path ahead.'\nThis means today you'll find a way to deal with a problem you've been unable to solve."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'The rising sun shines brightly, dispelling the mist and fog.'\nThis means you shouldn't worry if you run into difficulties, because you're bound to receive help."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'Clouds obscure the moon, the earth lies sleeping.'\nThis means the time isn't right for action, not everything is in place just yet."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'The sea serpent writhes, a storm is raging.'\nThis means you'll run into obstacles, no matter what you do."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'Forest wolves becry the moon, monsters lurk all around.'\nThis means you should watch out for people trying to obstruct your progress."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Today's Fortune
dialogues.text: "'Thunder roars and winds howl, destruction fills the air.'\nThis means your past achievements might be ruined in some way."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Read on...)

dialogues.speaker: Childishly Written Notice
dialogues.text: "Katya says it's not only customers who get to spin the wheel — passers-by can try their luck as well."

dialogues.speaker: Childishly Written Notice
dialogues.text: "But everything here belongs to 'Speranza.' Don't go taking anything away — Pavlov's watching!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Leave.)
